item.title: VialHaus Cold
item.description: A cold, quiet box for the vials you are using this week. The VialHaus Cold keeps up to 28 vials at the temperature you set, on a nightstand, a desk or a hotel counter. It runs on its own battery for most of a day, then on the wall adapter, a car USB port or a power bank. It ships from a warehouse inside the US, so it reaches you in 3 to 8 days, and there is never a customs bill at the door. What it does Set your own temperature. Touch control on the lid, adjustable from 32 to 64 F (0 to 18 C) in one-degree steps, with the current reading on the display. Built for vials, not pens. A divided tray takes up to 28 x 3 ml vials upright, so you can see what you have and pull the one you need. 10 ml vials and pens lie flat in the side bay. Runs anywhere. Built-in 13,600 mAh battery rated for 10 to 20 hours, plus a US wall adapter, car USB and power bank charging. A low-battery alarm tells you before it stops. Quiet. No compressor. Rated at 18 to 25 dB, quieter than a whisper, so it can sit next to your bed. Easy to keep clean. Sandblasted aluminium liner, sealed lid, fold-down handle. The temperature question, answered honestly This is a thermoelectric cooler. It cools relative to the room, not to a fixed number no matter what. In a normal room, up to about 75 F, it holds the 36 to 46 F range most people store at. In a hot car or a room above about 80 F it will run warmer than the set point, and direct sun makes it worse. Most sellers of this kind of box do not tell you that. Those are the manufacturer's figures. We are logging our own temperature data at different room temperatures, and the chart goes on this page when it is done. Until then, keep a thermometer in it for the first few days so you know how it behaves in your room. This is a storage and travel box with active cooling. It is not a replacement for a refrigerator, and it is not a medical device. Shipping and returns Ships free from a warehouse inside the US. Most orders arrive in 3 to 8 days, with tracking. No import charges, ever. 60-day returns for any reason, and we pay the return label. If it stops cooling in the first 60 days, we replace it. 2-year cover Choose "Standard + 2-year cover" and the replacement promise runs two years from delivery. If the Cold stops cooling, we send you another one. No forms, just email hello@vialhaus.com. In the box VialHaus Cold unit with divided tray US wall adapter and USB cable The VialHaus digital kit: web Date Tracker, printable label sheet, and a travel card with the actual TSA and EU wording Flying with it The built-in battery is about 50 Wh, under the 100 Wh limit airlines apply to devices with lithium cells, so it travels in carry-on. TSA compliant and carry-on approved: TSA lets cooling accessories for medically necessary items through screening, and the travel card in your kit quotes the exact TSA and EU wording to show the officer. Specifications Holds up to 28 x 3 ml vials upright, or pens and 10 ml vials flat Inside 7.3 x 4.1 x 1.6 in (186 x 105 x 40 mm) Outside 9.6 x 8.1 x 7.3 in (245 x 205 x 185 mm), about 5 lb Thermoelectric cooling, adjustable 32 to 64 F (0 to 18 C) 13,600 mAh rechargeable battery (about 50 Wh), 10 to 20 hours Touch control with digital readout, low-battery alarm Product images are manufacturer renders.
